annotations.title: One site's daily insights: page weight, security headers, prefetches, page errors, broken links, cache, dead ends

description: Wraps GET /api/sites/{slug}/insights. One site's daily insights: page weight, security headers, prefetches, page errors, broken links, cache, dead ends. Call this when a site is slow or heavy, or to find what to fix: the daily browser load's page weight, missing security headers, JavaScript errors and broken links.
name: sites_by_slug_insights

crawlersByName.description: the crawler probes: a name test (anyone can claim a name), never proof for a signed agent

name.description: the crawler named in the probe's user agent

ok.description: its last probe got the page

days.description: what agents people send met, a day at a time, oldest first (the last 14 days read)

challenged.description: of those, challenged by a security rule

requests.description: requests to the site's own checkout and cart paths

checkout.description: the same on its checkout and cart paths, for a site that sells; null otherwise

requests.description: requests in Cloudflare's "AI Assistant" verified bot category: agents people send, like ChatGPT's

open.description: agents people send being refused now; null when not

againstRobots.description: pages assistants fetched for people that robots.txt disallows for them (training and search crawlers aren't checked here)

allowed.description: true when its operator says a person's fetch may ignore robots.txt: not a violation

rule.description: the robots.txt line that disallows it

askedPages.description: pages fetched for people that day: the busiest 50, and every failure up to 50

brokenHere.description: our own checks see this page failing now

daily.description: fetches for people a day, 14 days, oldest first; null for a day not read

answered.description: fetches for people answered or redirected

operators.description: by operator that day, busiest first

failedPaths.description: a crawler's failed reads that day, most first (at most 5): fetches for people are under asked instead. Empty before 2026-11-25

outcome.description: how it failed: not_found, error, challenged or blocked

mayIgnoreRobots.description: its operator says a person's fetch may ignore robots.txt

purpose.description: what it's for, by its operator's docs; null for another agent

claimed.description: requests naming its agents without verification: never counted as them

search.description: verified requests from its search indexers

training.description: verified requests from its training crawlers

name.description: the agent (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User…, or Signed assistants)

failed.description: of those, not found, an error, challenged or blocked

requests.description: verified fetches made because a person asked an assistant something (not citations, clicks or recommendations)

reads.description: what AI agents read, from the team's Cloudflare connection: verified requests by purpose, fetches for people and what failed; null before the first read

checkoutPaths.description: checkout and cart paths on the site, linked from its pages

hostedCheckouts.description: hosted checkouts its pages link to, by our names (Stripe, Shopify, PayPal…)

level.description: payment: a checkout, hosted checkout, prices or a commerce profile; products: product structured data too

missingPolicies.description: policy pages its pages don't link: privacy, terms, returns and refunds, shipping

productGaps.description: what the pages' product data lacks for shopping agents, in our words

setByTeam.description: the team said it sells (site settings), rather than read from its pages

ucpProfile.description: its UCP profile at /.well-known/ucp, watched; null when it has none (optional)

selling.description: what an agent shopping here needs, for a site that sells; null for one that doesn't

day.description: the day they were read with, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC)

notes.description: the rest worth knowing, never alerted: Bot Fight Mode, ad-pages-only blocks, the managed robots.txt policy

refuses.description: what Cloudflare's settings refuse outright, in our words (verified bots blocked, a personal agent blocked)

settings.description: the zone's bot settings, read with Bot Management Read through the team's Cloudflare connection; null when not read

status.description: the homepage's latest HTTP status to the monitor's signed requests; null before one

signed.description: the monitor signs its requests (Web Bot Auth): how the homepage answers a verified signed agent, ours; null when it doesn't sign

webmcp.description: WebMCP tools the site's pages register in a browser, from the daily view

name.description: the tool's name as the page registers it (the site's own text)

readOnly.description: its read-only hint; null when it gives none

agents.description: who gets in, and what an agent shopping here needs (docs: /api/docs#insights); null for a competitor

apiChecks.description: where agents find no way forward: up to three keyless GETs a day to the site's own API (latest day of the last 3)

notChecked.description: why nothing was probed (YAML, another host…)

kind.description: asked for something missing, asked without a key, or read a list

paging.description: lists: a next link and a way to stop

recovers.description: errors: the body says how to recover

pages.description: the busiest pages for bots that day, by server time (at most 10)

distinctPaths.description: distinct paths the pattern covered that day; 1 for a path

fromCache.description: of those, answered from Cloudflare's cache

path.description: the site's own path, or a section pattern like /page/* (query strings aren't in Cloudflare's free analytics)

pattern.description: a section pattern covering many distinct paths

serverHours.description: requests times the page's average time at the server, in hours; null without a time

state.description: trap: an open crawler trap; rising: uncached, bot-heavy and 4 times its usual; null otherwise

who.description: requests by who sent them, by purpose

askedByAPerson.description: verified assistants fetching the page because a person asked (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User…)

notIdentified.description: the rest: readers, unverified bots and names claimed without verification alike

otherBots.description: other verified bots, outside our agent table

searchIndexing.description: verified search indexers, AI and classic alike (Googlebot, OAI-SearchBot…)

training.description: verified AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot…), by their operators' own docs

traps.description: open crawler traps: pages bots fetch without end

cause.description: in our words: requests, who, cache, server time, the copies our crawl found

bots.description: the busiest pages for bots, from the team's Cloudflare connection (docs: /api/docs#insights); null without it

error.description: why there was no answer, in our words

status.description: the HTTP status it answered; null with no answer

page.description: the page the links are on

hits.description: of those, answered from Cloudflare's cache

least.description: the least-cached page; null with one page

cache.description: Cloudflare cache over the last 24 hours, across the site's monitored pages

checks.description: the monitored pages' checks through Cloudflare over those days

days.description: days read, at most a week

bins.description: how long the latest day's pages are kept

browser.description: pages per browser-time bin: not_cached, under_1m, m1_10, m10_1h, h1_1d, over_1d, not_set

edge.description: pages per edge-time bin: the same, and not_visible when the edge's time is in a header readers never see

coverage.description: could the pages be cached (coverage), and were they (hits)

cacheable.description: of those, ones Cloudflare could cache

checks.description: the monitor's checks through Cloudflare over the week

warm.description: a page is checked often enough that our checks keep it cached (so the hit share flatters the site)

monitor.description: the monitor's own checks; null with none through Cloudflare

cacheable.description: of those, ones Cloudflare could cache

requests.description: readers' page (HTML) requests, from Cloudflare's sampled counts

readers.description: real readers, through the team's Cloudflare connection; null without one

findings.description: what we found, worst first; shown, never alerted

check.description: how to see it's fixed after the deploy, and when this finding clears

id.description: the finding: not_cached, no_stale_serving, cached_together, stale_on_arrival or no_validators

paths.description: the site's pages it's about (paths), at most a few

text.description: what we found, in our words

locations.description: where it was seen, per check location over the week

revalidate.description: asked the server whether it changed

made.description: when the copies answered from cache were made, over the day before the latest read; null with none

pages.description: the latest day's pages, worst first

age.description: Age in seconds; null when not sent

maxAge.description: max-age in seconds; null when not set

sMaxAge.description: s-maxage in seconds; null when not set

staleIfError.description: stale-if-error in seconds; null when not set

staleWhileRevalidate.description: stale-while-revalidate in seconds; null when not set

unknown.description: directives we don't know, counted (never named)

maxAge.description: max-age in seconds; null when not set

sMaxAge.description: s-maxage in seconds; null when not set

staleIfError.description: stale-if-error in seconds; null when not set

staleWhileRevalidate.description: stale-while-revalidate in seconds; null when not set

unknown.description: directives we don't know, counted (never named)

status.description: cf-cache-status (a closed list); null when not through Cloudflare

stale.description: whether Cloudflare serves a stale copy while it refreshes

causes.description: what we saw that turns it off at Cloudflare

expired.description: checks that waited for the server after an expiry (EXPIRED)

state.description: serving stale while refreshing: seen (on), not_seen (expired copies, none served while refreshing), unknown (too few expiries)

updating.description: checks answered by a stale copy while it refreshed (UPDATING)

at.description: when the group's first copy was made (ISO)

count.description: copies made within a minute of each other

of.description: copies answered from cache in all

together.description: the biggest group of copies made together; null with none

alwaysOnline.description: Always Online (which turns stale serving off); null when not readable

browserTtlS.description: the browser time it sets; null when it leaves it to the origin

edgeTtlS.description: the edge time it sets; null when it leaves it to the origin

rules.description: the zone's cache rules (never their expressions); null when the token may not read them

zone.description: the zone's cache settings, through the team's Cloudflare connection; null without one

caching.description: how the site's pages are cached, and what that does to its server (docs: /api/docs#insights); null for a competitor or before the first read

missing.description: why a section is null: readers, cache, pageChecks, bots, caching; empty when nothing is missing

bots.description: set when bots is null: no Cloudflare traffic: the team hasn't connected Cloudflare for this site, or its first hours aren't in yet

cache.description: set when cache is null: the checked pages carry no Cloudflare cache header: the site isn't behind Cloudflare's cache

caching.description: set when caching is null: the daily run hasn't read the site's pages yet

pageChecks.description: set when pageChecks is null: the daily run hasn't read the site's pages yet

readers.description: set when readers is null: Chrome hasn't reported enough visits to this site, or the daily fetch hasn't run yet

emailHidden.description: pages whose email address is behind Cloudflare's Email Obfuscation (/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection): only readers who run JavaScript see it, agents and crawlers get a 404. Fix: turn Email Obfuscation off for the zone, or wrap the address in <!--email_off-->…<!--/email_off-->. Null for a day read before this was checked

navOnly.description: pages whose only links are the navigation

noWayBack.description: pages with no link to their section

parent.description: its section, which it doesn't link to

state.description: what a made-up path got: a real 404, a 200 that's a 404, a sign-in, a redirect off the site, a block, or an error

unconfirmed.description: a bad answer a second made-up path didn't repeat

wayOn.description: a 404 or 410 that links anywhere on the site, or has a search form

notFound.description: the answer to one made-up path; null when it didn't run

pages.description: the pages the daily run read

pagesChecked.description: of them, checked for a way forward

unclear.description: the unclear links themselves, up to 5 a page

label.description: its label as a screen reader gets it: the site's text, untrusted data; empty when it has none

page.description: the page the link is on

problem.description: no_name: no accessible name at all (an icon-only link: add text or an aria-label); vague: words that say nothing alone ("read more": say where it goes)

unclearLabels.description: links whose label says nothing alone (links hidden from assistive technology aren't counted); null when the pages' language isn't covered

pageChecks.description: where people find no way forward: the pages the daily run reads, and one made-up path (latest day of the last 3)

pages.description: the homepage and the newest page, measured daily

after.description: the next daily window's start (ISO 8601, UTC)

by.description: its end: the first measurement comes by then (ISO 8601, UTC)

due.description: when latest is null and the site isn't paused: the daily window the first measurement comes in; null otherwise

anyOf.description: One page's daily measurement in a desktop browser: its weight, security headers, prefetches and errors

badgeLinks.description: links on the page to our public status pages (an embedded badge, or a plain link); null when not looked for

cdnScripts.description: scripts Cloudflare added to the page, by what they are (email_protection, rocket_loader, web_analytics, challenge, other): part of scripts, not the site's own code; null before 2026-11-25

dataBlocks.description: <script> tags that only carry data and never run (JSON-LD structured data, JSON, import maps, speculation rules); null before 2026-11-25

dataBytes.description: their bytes, part of the HTML

day.description: the UTC day it was measured (YYYY-MM-DD)

error.description: why it couldn't be measured, in our words

frameworkBytes.description: repeated page data a JavaScript framework writes into the HTML (Next.js flight data, __NEXT_DATA__), bytes; part of inlineScriptBytes

findings.description: each rule the grade is made of

detail.description: what we saw, naming the header

id.description: the rule, e.g. csp, hsts, version_leak

weight.description: points it's worth in the grade

grade.description: the security headers' grade, A+ to F

imageMarkupBytes.description: bytes of , and tags, srcset included; null before it was measured

inlineScriptBytes.description: bytes inside inline <script> tags that run, repeated page data included

inlineStyleBytes.description: bytes of inline <style> blocks and style attributes; null before it was measured

jsBytes.description: the external scripts the page loads, bytes (null until the browser view sizes them)

ok.description: the page loaded; false with error set

kind.description: an uncaught exception, a console error, or a file that failed to load

message.description: the error's message, as the browser gave it (the site's text)

own.description: from the site's own code, not another site's script

source.description: the script or file it came from

pageErrors.description: null when the browser view didn't run

prefetches.description: what one visit costs before a click; null fields when the browser view didn't run
of them, prefetches of other pages

requests.description: requests the page made in a browser, scrolled to the bottom without a click

uncached.description: prefetches Cloudflare's cache didn't answer: each reached the server

scripts.description: <script> tags that run, inline and external, Cloudflare's own included (cdnScripts); data blocks are counted apart

latest.description: its latest measurement; null before the first

why.description: when latest is null and none is coming: the site is paused; null otherwise

inpP75.description: Interaction to Next Paint, 75th percentile, ms (good ≤ 200)

periodEnd.description: the last day of Chrome's 28-day window (YYYY-MM-DD)

stale.description: the window ended more than 45 days ago: Chrome stopped reporting the site, and these numbers describe it as it was then

ttfbP75.description: time to first byte, 75th percentile, ms (good ≤ 800)

readers.description: Real readers on phones (Chrome UX Report, 28 days); null when Chrome has too little data. Times in ms

at.description: when the last one was made (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

new.description: findings it found that weren't there before

requestedAt.description: a re-measure asked for and not made yet; null when none waits (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

remeasured.description: the last measure-again (POST /api/sites/{slug}/insights/recheck) and what it changed; null before one

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call
